title: Harrd Core Sisters
style:
Generate an original, heartfelt, high-emotion birthday duet song in Suno v5.5 titled "Beautiful Soul Sista (Release the Love Bulls 900 Phonk Mixup)". This is a loving personal message between two real sisters — Michelle and Charm — singing directly to each other on Michelle’s birthday. The core message is: “I know my sister is always here for me even though we are not geographically close. I feel her support every single day. Her endless unconditional love extends far across every mile. You are so appreciated, sis — now it’s time for you to thrive in full peace of mind and heart.”

Style blend: Classic 1960s swing ballad (warm upright bass, brushed drums, gentle piano, light horn swells, girl-group harmonies) fused with modern 900 phonk mixup elements — deep sub-bass from live beatboxing, signature vinyl record scratches, soft cowbell hits on the off-beats, lo-fi vinyl crackle, and groovy phonk swing that never overpowers the emotional 60s ballad heart. Tempo 82-86 BPM. Female duet
lyrics:
[Intro – 0:00 to 0:18]  
Bass beatboxer starts alone in a cozy dark room: slow deep “boom… boom… boom” chest bass + gentle vinyl “shhhht… ts-ts… shhhht” scratches like an old record waking up. Faint warm piano chords and soft brushed snare enter. Distant female hums “mmm-hmm… happy birthday…” in perfect sister harmony. Gentle vinyl crackle throughout. Feels like two sisters putting on their favourite old karaoke tape from the chat history.

[Verse 1 – Charm – 0:18 to 0:52]  
Warm, intimate, slightly smiling vocal, light swing groove.  
“Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista  
Even though we’re miles and miles apart  
I still feel you right here in my heart  
Your support lifts me every single day  
Your love stretches farther than words can say  
You are appreciated, sis — now it’s time for you”

[Pre-Chorus – Both sisters + light beatbox accents – 0:52 to 1:10]  
Harmonies bloom, beatboxer adds soft “tsk-tsk” scratches like turning pages of old videos.  
“Through every karaoke night we sang till dawn  
Through every pickleball win you charged on strong  
You move like a bull — fierce, unstoppable, free  
But your heart stays soft and safe for me”

[Chorus – Full duet harmony + bigger beatboxer – 1:10 to 1:45]  
Both sisters together, rich layered harmonies, beatboxer drops deeper “boom-bap” and celebratory scratches on the 2 and 4. Uplifting 60s girl-group feel with phonk glow.  
“Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista!  
May you thrive in peace of mind and heart  
Release the bulls of joy on your special day  
Love that never fades, never goes away  
You’re my rock, my cheerleader from so far  
I feel your love no matter where you are  
Happy birthday, beautiful soul sista!”

[Verse 2 – Michelle – 1:45 to 2:20]  
Stronger, more powerful vocal, proud and grateful, beatboxer adds funky bass runs underneath.  
“Thank you, sis, for always showing up for me  
Your words wrap around me like family  
I play my pickleball, I swing and I fight  
But your air hugs heal everything right  
We laugh at old videos, we sing every song  
Our bond is forever — it can never go wrong  
You know my heart, you send your light  
Unconditional love, day and night”

[Pre-Chorus 2 – Both – 2:20 to 2:38]  
Same as first pre-chorus but with extra warmth and a little beatbox “pow-pow” flourish.

[Chorus 2 – Bigger duet – 2:38 to 3:10]  
Fuller harmonies, beatboxer adds extra scratches and bass drops for phonk energy while keeping swing elegance. Ad-libs: “yeah my sista”, “love you always”, “air hug coming through”.

[Bridge – Bass Beatboxer showcase + spoken-sung sisters – 3:10 to 3:35]  
Beatboxer takes the spotlight for 12 seconds of pure live scratching and deep bass percussion (vinyl spin, rapid “ts-ts-ts-ts”, heavy “boom-boom-boom” drops). Sisters speak-sing over the top with huge smiles in their voices:  
“Even when we’re not close geographically  
Your love still reaches and wraps around me  
Like the bull you are on the court so strong  
Today we release the love bulls — all day long!”

[Final Chorus – Epic layered – 3:35 to 4:05]  
Both sisters double-tracked, rich 60s harmonies + modern phonk warmth, beatboxer at full power with celebratory scratches and bass. Multiple ad-libs flying: “happy birthday beautiful”, “thrive in peace”, “I feel you sis”, “love you forever”.

[Outro – 4:05 to 4:25]  
Everything gently fades: beatboxer slows to soft “boom… boom…” and final gentle scratches like a record slowing down. Sisters whisper together in perfect harmony:  
“Happy birthday, my beautiful soul sista…  
May you thrive in peace of mind and heart…  
I feel your love… always… always…”

End with one last soft vinyl scratch and a warm “mmm-hmm” hum that melts into silence.
